** Minor** · **Stability & Availability** · **Quick win** **Destroy the window when its renderer fails to load. Otherwise the card never appears again in that session.** `load` calls `void browserWindow.loadURL(...)` and `void browserWindow.loadFile(...)`. A rejected load is not handled. Two things then go wrong: - The rejection is unhandled in the main process. - `RecordingReadyWindow.show()` has already returned `true`, so the recording page never shows its in-app fallback. `rendererReady` stays `false`, so `present()` never shows anything. The window is not destroyed, so `ensureWindow()` returns early on every later `show()`. The user then loses the "Your video is ready" card until restart. Catch the rejection and destroy the window. The existing `closed` handler then clears `this.window`, and the next `show()` creates a fresh window.
Proposed fix
```diff --- "a/apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-ready-window.ts" +++ "b/apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-ready-window.ts" @@ -255,18 +255,24 @@ return new RecordingReadyWindow({ ...app, createWindow: (options) => new BrowserWindow(options), load: (window) => { const browserWindow = window as BrowserWindow; + const onFailure = (error: unknown): void => { + console.error("[recording-ready] the card window failed to load", error); + if (!browserWindow.isDestroyed()) browserWindow.destroy(); + }; if (is.dev && process.env["ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL"]) { - void browserWindow.loadURL( - `${process.env["ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL"]}/?window=recording-ready`, - ); + browserWindow + .loadURL(`${process.env["ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL"]}/?window=recording-ready`) + .catch(onFailure); } else { - void browserWindow.loadFile(join(__dirname, "../renderer/index.html"), { - search: "?window=recording-ready", - }); + browserWindow + .loadFile(join(__dirname, "../renderer/index.html"), { + search: "?window=recording-ready", + }) + .catch(onFailure); } }, ipc: ipcMain, screen: { getAllDisplays: () => screen.getAllDisplays(), ```
The PR description notes this gap. The one-time failure still would not trigger the in-app fallback. The fix keeps later recordings working.
Committable suggestion
> **IMPORTANT** > Review the replacement and indentation, then test before committing. ```suggestion load: (window) => { const browserWindow = window as BrowserWindow; const onFailure = (error: unknown): void => { console.error("[recording-ready] the card window failed to load", error); if (!browserWindow.isDestroyed()) browserWindow.destroy(); }; if (is.dev && process.env["ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL"]) { browserWindow .loadURL(`${process.env["ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL"]}/?window=recording-ready`) .catch(onFailure); } else { browserWindow .loadFile(join(__dirname, "../renderer/index.html"), { search: "?window=recording-ready", }) .catch(onFailure); } ```

This lets the existing `closed` handler clear `this.window`, allowing a later `show()` to create a fresh window. After applying the fix, consider running `coderabbit review --agent` for local review.
